articles.title: Ben Shelton Smashes His Way to First US Open Final
articles.summary: Ben Shelton beat Frances Tiafoe in a huge all-American semifinal to reach his first Grand Slam final. He's the first Black American man in the US Open final since Arthur Ashe in 1972. Next up: Alexander Zverev on Sunday.

articles.title: A Rocket Part Just Smashed Into the Moon!
articles.summary: A piece of space junk — an old SpaceX rocket part — crashed into the Moon on August 5, 2026. It made a crater 60 feet wide! Scientists are studying it to learn about space debris.

articles.title: Tiny Robots Could Help Fight Brain Cancer
articles.summary: Scientists at MIT made tiny nanoantennas — 100 times thinner than a hair — that can be injected to kill brain cancer cells. In tests, they shrank tumors and helped mice live longer without side effects.
